Item.AmberClasp.Name: The Amber Clasp
Item.AmberClasp.Desc: Fossilized resin encased in iron. A Timberline custom. An emblem of ties that bind the present in place.
AmberClasp.Reject.Unavailable: I'm not ready for that kind of commitment right now.
AmberClasp.Reject.LowHearts: I don't know you well enough for that yet.
Jett.Proposal.Accept: Is this... Amber? You want to save this? Us? ...I never thought I could commit to something this complicated. But with you? Yeah, let’s do it. I’m all yours.$h
Jett.Proposal.RejectVanilla: A shell? The old sea dog down by the coast sells these. It’s nice, really... but I need something rugged. Something that can take a bit of abuse. Something that won’t break so easily.
Arden.Proposal.RejectVanilla: A shell? I believe the coastal settlements use these. It's a charming superstition, but... it's not *us*, is it? It's too... temporary.
Arden.Proposal.RejectFear: Amber... preserved forever. It's beautiful. But I... I can't accept it. We agreed to stay safe, remember? If I take this, I risk losing everything. I can't do it.$s
Arden.Proposal.Accept: Amber. A moment frozen in time... held by iron. You remembered.$l#$b#Yes. I will take it. Even if it breaks one day... having it now is worth the cost. I'm yours.
Roxy.Proposal.RejectVanilla: Whoa! Is that... a Mermaid's Pendant? Ideally, this is where I scream and cry and we plan a wedding. But... no. I can't do the white dress. I can't do the ceremony.$s#$b#But... I hate my apartment. And I... kinda don't hate you. So how about this: I move in. We're partners. Roommates with benefits. We figure it out. Deal?$l
Roxy.Proposal.Accept: An Amber Clasp? Seriously? That's so... old school. And permanent. ...Okay. Yeah. Put it on me before I panic.
Cassidy.Proposal.Accept: An Amber Clasp?! For me?! Oh my Yoba! Yes! A thousand times yes! Wait, I need to breathe! Yes!
Cassidy.Proposal.RejectVanilla: A pendant? It's pretty... but I don't think I can wear jewelry while I work. Sorry!
